name: John Mark
summary: John, also called Mark, whose mother's house was a place where believers gathered to pray. He helped Barnabas and Saul, left them partway through a journey, and later Paul asked for him as one useful in the ministry.

key_moments.title: Leaves Paul and Barnabas at Perga
key_moments.description: Barnabas and Saul took John Mark with them from Jerusalem, and he helped them as they preached in Cyprus. But when they reached Perga in Pamphylia, John left them and went back to Jerusalem.

key_moments.title: Sails to Cyprus with Barnabas
key_moments.description: Barnabas wanted to take Mark on the next journey, but Paul refused because Mark had left them in Pamphylia. They argued so sharply that they parted, and Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus.

key_moments.title: Called For by Paul
key_moments.description: Paul told Timothy that only Luke was with him and asked him to bring Mark along, because Mark was useful to him in the ministry.
